addresses.comment: **Read whole 2026-10-11.** Slot 6, asked by CProductionView::BuildTooltip while the window is shown. `out` at [ebp+8], the element at [ebp+0xC]; each arm compares the element's slot 17 (its name) with a literal. terrainbonus: `text` = the terrain summary at +0x1D4. sort_prio BUILD_PRIO_IRO, BUILD_PRIO_DRO delayed. sort_X and total_X for str, sa, ha, piercing, armored, ad, org, cw, aa, def, tou, speed (BUILD_SPEED_DD), sup, sc, sof, and sort_fc with total_oc (the files' own name): BUILD_*_IRO, BUILD_*_DRO delayed. sort_ic, sort_mp, sort_time (BUILD_TIME_DD), sort_off (BUILD_OFF_DD) the same with no total. combined_arms_bonus_value BUILD_CA_BONUS_VALUE. parallel_minus, parallell_plus, serial_minus, serial_plus: BUILD_ADD_REM_BUNDLE with NUM = 10 (AppendLocalisedLine). A name beginning combined_arms_indicator_: the number after it (atoi), and for one above 0 the combined arms group of that index in the unit database's vector, its name (0x5B1BA0) and its key + `_desc` localised delayed. Anything else: empty. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildertooltips.md, section 1 and 2.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7EA930..0x7EC530, `ret 8`, returns `out` in EAX; the arms' targets mapped by script and three read through (0x7EAA2D, 0x7EB43E..0x7EB552, 0x7EB557..0x7EB5A3).

addresses.comment: The last of CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip's questions, by the element's name (+8): `topbar` (the top bar's), the message categories, the speed buttons, on_complete_impact, on_complete_icon, trait_icon (name, description in `delayed`), technology icons (TC_BUILD_COST_AND_TIME), message_dialog (CEU3Idler_MessageDialogTooltip), else CInGameIdler_ViewTooltip; then trims `text` and `delayed`. The four builder windows put the category key of the unit's practical there with the element's slot 30 as they fill it. Found: `text` = the category's name + " " + TC_BUILD_COST_AND_TIME + " §Y" + FormatFixedPoint(CCountry::GetCategoryBuildDiscount(the played country, category) * 100, 1) + "%§W". Not found: empty. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildertooltips.md, section 3.

addresses.name: BuildLedgerColumnTooltip
addresses.comment: **Renamed 2026-10-11: the ledger's, not the builders'.** One caller, CInGameIdler_ViewTooltip, when the idler's +0x1CE0 is set; the receiver in ECX is the element under the mouse and `out` is on the stack (`ret 4`). It asks the element's slot 17 for `TableItemText` first and then for each `ledger_sort_*` name of interface/hoi3ledgericons.gui, answering BUILD_*_IRO with BUILD_*_DRO - the same keys the four builder windows' own slot 6 routines use, which is where the old name came from. The builders do not call it. Read no further; that +0x1CE0 is the ledger is inferred from the names it answers. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildertooltips.md, section 4.

addresses.name: CDivisionDesigner::UpdateDesign
addresses.comment: **Works the design out and writes every figure of it.** `ret 4`, the designer on the stack. Per brigade of the list at +0x1B4: a CRegiment of the type with every technology at the country's level (CTechnologyStatus +0x218), ApplyTechnologies, and a copy of its definition. **Sums**: max_strength, width, soft, hard and air attack, defensiveness, toughness, air defence, suppression, supply and fuel consumption. **Averages**: max_organisation and softness (+0x1D0), and every adjuster - `sum * 1000 / (count * 1000)`. **The least**: max_speed. **The greatest**: piercing_attack and armor. Manpower (+0x1C8) is the sum of CCountry::GetBuildCostManpower with the `as_reserves` checkbox; days the greatest GetBuildTime * 1000; IC a day (+0x1CC) the sum of `GetBuildCostIC * days / 1000`, times 1000 over the greatest days - RecalculateCost's arithmetic. Shown: `ic_cost_value` times parallel and `mp_cost_value` times serial * parallel, two decimals; `build_time_value` days times serial as `N DAYS` up to 365 and `N / 30 MONTHS` above. The combined arms indicators, the terrain tooltip text (+0x1D4), the `on_complete_box` entries and the traffic light - green when `GetICPart(production) - GetUsedIC() - cost >= 0`, orange when the first two leave anything, red otherwise - are all here too. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-builders.md, section 2. **The terrain summary at +0x1D4, read 2026-10-11:** for each brigade it adds its own adjuster for each terrain (+0x54) and, to that terrain's attack and defence, the terrain's own (+0x50, +0x4C); to its river, night, fort and amphibious adjusters (+0x94, +0x64, +0x7C, +0xAC) it adds them with RIVER_CROSSING_PENALTY, BASE_NIGHT_PENALTY, BASE_FORT_PENALTY and AMPHIBIOUS_LANDING_PENALTY added to the attack. Every adjuster is then divided by the brigades (CUnitAdjuster::Divide, by the count in thousandths). The text: for each terrain in the map's order whose CUnitAdjuster_Describe is not empty, its name + ": " + that + "\n"; then RIVER_ADJUSTER, NIGHT_ADJUSTER, FORT_ADJUSTER and AMPH_ADJUSTER the same. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildertooltips.md, section 3.
